title: A Picture of a Blessed Home
overview: This short song paints the good life that comes to someone who honors God: honest work, a thriving family, and peace for their people.

parts.label: Who is truly happy (vv. 1-2)
parts.note: Fearing the LORD here means a deep respect for God that shows in how a person lives, not terror. The first reward is simple: to enjoy what your own hands have earned, without it being taken by hardship, harsh rulers or enemies.

parts.label: A thriving family (vv. 3-4)
parts.note: A vine heavy with grapes and young olive trees were familiar pictures of life and plenty in ancient Israel. Children gathered around the table suggest a family that is growing and will carry on.

parts.label: Blessing from Jerusalem (vv. 5-6)
parts.note: Zion is the hill in Jerusalem where the temple stood, the place Israel saw as the center of God's presence. The song widens from one home to the whole nation, hoping the person lives to see grandchildren and a people at peace.

disagreement: Christians differ on whether this psalm promises material comfort to the faithful or describes a general pattern of a wise life, since other parts of the Bible, like Job, openly face good people who suffer.
think: When you picture a good life, how much of it comes down to work, family and peace around you, and how much of that feels within your own control?
